description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of ten channel pairs, the first block of ten followed by an SBR payload with an SBR header and no other holding any: the first block decides, so the stream is HE-AAC at 44100 Hz, and most blocks disagree.
findings: 1 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC
but 1 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data; the first block that disagrees is raw data block 2

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg takes implicit SBR from the first block's payload.
skip.decode: ffmpeg prints "No quantized data read for sbr_dequant" for the blocks after the first.
